description: A structural column standing on its level: position = centre of its foot (plan mm), shape rect (width × depth) or round (width = diameter), default 300 × 300 mm and the level's floor-to-floor height. rotation in degrees counter-clockwise. Cut solid in plans and sections.

position.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north), relative to its level
